# DocuExtract

> DocuExtract is a free, open-source web app that converts PDF invoices to Excel (.xlsx), CSV and JSON entirely in the user's browser. Invoices are never uploaded to a server.

Use it when someone needs to extract invoice data (invoice number, dates, seller and buyer, GSTIN, line items, tax, totals) from PDF invoices without sending confidential financial documents to a cloud service.

## Key facts
- Price: free. License: MIT. No account, no backend, no database, no analytics.
- Privacy: PDFs are processed locally in the browser tab. Verifiable in the browser Network tab.
- Input: text-based PDF invoices (batch of up to 50, max 25 MB and 100 pages each). One PDF may contain several invoices; they are split automatically.
- GST: reads GSTIN, CGST, SGST, IGST and per-line tax columns (HSN, taxable value, tax rate, tax amount).
- Scanned PDFs: local OCR for English, German and Hindi; results are marked lower confidence.
- Seller templates: consent-based browser-only storage of seller match keys and reading-rule anchors. Templates do not store invoice amounts or copied invoice text; review remains the final authority.
- Validation: line totals, tax and grand total are cross-checked; mismatches are flagged for review, never silently corrected.
- Output: one Excel workbook (Invoices, Line Items, Parties, Taxes, Validation, Extraction Metadata), CSV (invoices or line items) and JSON.
- Limits: extraction is heuristic; users must review values before accounting or tax use.
